desc:
Checkout and payment testing after changes shows that your store still takes orders correctly on phones and desktops. Ecom Swift LLC places test orders the way shoppers do and reports a clear pass or fail for each path.

## What is checkout testing?

Checkout testing is the practice of placing real orders through your store in a controlled way, so you can see that every step works. A tester adds products to the cart, enters shipping details, applies codes, chooses a payment method and finishes the order. Afterward they check the confirmation page, the email, the stock level and the order record in your admin.

## Why a broken checkout often goes unnoticed

A failed checkout makes no noise. The shopper sees an error, closes the tab and moves on. Your sales report shows a quiet day, and nothing in the store tells you why.

Checkout is also the part most often touched by other work. A theme update, a new app, a shipping rule, a tax change or a payment setting can each alter how the final steps behave. Because the owner usually tests on one device with one product, a problem on a different phone or a different payment option can sit unseen.

## How testing protects revenue

By the time a shopper reaches checkout, they have already chosen to buy. Any failure there loses a sale that cost you traffic, ads or effort to win. Testing after each change catches the problem on a test order instead of on a customer.

It also protects trust. A wrong shipping rate, a missing confirmation email or a discount that stacks by mistake can create refunds and support work. Checking these paths in advance keeps the experience consistent from the first click to the confirmation message.

## What a thorough checkout test covers

- Orders placed with different products, quantities and variants.
- Phone and desktop paths, on more than one browser.
- Shipping rates for several destinations and methods.
- Discount codes, automatic discounts and gift cards.
- Each payment method that you offer, in a safe test mode where available.
- Tax display and totals for domestic and international orders.
- Failed payment messages and the retry flow.
- Order confirmation email, with correct items and totals.
- Stock levels after the order completes.
- The order record in your admin, including customer and shipping fields.

## What we do

We agree the test plan with you first, based on how your customers actually buy. Then we place the orders, using test mode, a test payment method or a sandbox where your payment provider offers one. Where only live testing is possible, we agree the method with you in advance, so you stay in control of any order that touches a real payment.

For each path we record what we did, what we expected and what happened, with screenshots. You receive a simple pass or fail list. If something fails, we describe the likely cause and the fix, and you can ask us to make the repair. The Basic package checks one path on phone and desktop. Standard adds shipping, discounts and payment variety. Premium covers international, subscription or pre-order flows, failed payments and a checklist your team can reuse after every change.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Test after every theme change, app install and shipping or tax edit.
- Include at least one test on a real phone.
- Use a test mode for payments and tag test orders so you can find them.
- Check the email the customer receives, not only the screen.
- Keep a short checklist and repeat it before big sales.

**Avoid:**
- Testing only the path you use yourself.
- Leaving test orders mixed into your real reports without a tag.
- Assuming a payment method works because it worked last month.
- Skipping the confirmation email check.
- Launching a sale without a trial order that uses the sale discount.

## Who this is for

This suits a store that has just changed theme, apps or shipping and wants proof that buying still works. It suits a seller preparing a major sale who cannot afford a failed checkout. It also suits a store that has noticed a gap between visits and orders and wants to rule out a technical cause.

## What we need from you

Tell us which products, shipping destinations, discounts and payment methods matter most, and add us as a collaborator, staff or admin user. We never ask for passwords or card details. For payment testing we use the test options your provider supplies, and we agree any other method with you first.
